channel.title: MintWave Studio Blog
channel.description: Practical guides from the makers of Cable Calc, MultiTimer, Days Until, Daily Budget, Hatch Day, Sire & Dam and Endly.

item.title: The 50/30/20 budget rule explained, and how to turn it into a daily number
item.description: The 50/30/20 rule splits income into needs, wants and savings. See a worked example and how to convert the wants share into a daily spending limit.

item.title: How long do opened foods last in the fridge? A shelf-life chart
item.description: How long opened jars, tins, cheese, sauces and leftovers last in the fridge. A typical shelf-life chart, the opened-date habit and how to track it.

item.title: What size cable for a 7.4 kW home EV charger?
item.description: A 7.4 kW EV charger is a 32 A load. See the copper cable size by run length and installation method, the breaker and RCD rules, and a checklist before you install.

item.title: HIIT and Tabata timer: how to set the work and rest intervals
item.description: Tabata is 20 seconds of work and 10 of rest for 8 rounds. See common HIIT work/rest ratios, how to set an interval timer and the mistakes that ruin a session.

item.title: How often do dogs go into heat? Heat cycle stages, length and signs
item.description: Dogs usually go into heat about every 6 months. The four stages (proestrus, estrus, diestrus, anestrus), how long each lasts and how to predict the next heat.

item.title: How to rate endometriosis pain on a 0 to 10 scale
item.description: How to use the 0 to 10 pain scale for endometriosis: what each number means, how to stay consistent, and how to describe pain so your doctor can use it.

item.title: How to budget on weekly, biweekly or twice-a-month pay
item.description: Budget when you are not paid monthly: why 52 weeks is not 4 weeks a month, the two extra paychecks a year, and a daily budget per pay period.

item.title: When to stop turning eggs: lockdown day for chicken, duck and quail
item.description: When to stop turning eggs and start lockdown: day 18 for chickens, 25 for ducks, 14 for quail. Humidity, what to do, and what not to do before hatch.

item.title: Passport, ID and licence expiry: when to renew and how to never miss it
item.description: Passports, ID cards and driving licences expire without warning. When to renew, the 6-month rule for travel and how to set expiry reminders that work.

item.title: Pomodoro technique: how to set up your timer and adjust the 25/5 rhythm
item.description: The Pomodoro technique uses 25-minute focus blocks and 5-minute breaks. How to set up a Pomodoro timer, when to change the lengths and mistakes to avoid.

item.title: What size breaker for a cable? Match the breaker to the cable (IEC 60364)
item.description: Choose a breaker for a cable with Ib ≤ In ≤ Iz (IEC 60364): worked examples for 2.5, 4 and 6 mm² copper, and why a bigger breaker is unsafe.

item.title: How much can I spend per day? Work out a daily budget in 5 steps
item.description: Work out how much you can spend per day: income minus bills and savings, divided by days to payday. Worked example, overspending and big costs.

item.title: Progesterone timing for dog breeding: when to mate after the LH surge
item.description: How progesterone testing finds ovulation: baseline, LH surge and ovulation values in ng/mL and nmol/L, and the best days to breed by semen type.

item.title: Why didn't my eggs hatch? Causes by candling stage and fixes
item.description: Eggs not hatching? Find the cause by candling stage: infertility, early and late deaths, temperature, humidity and turning, with fixes for next time.

item.title: Best before vs use by: what food date labels really mean
item.description: Best before is about quality, use by is about safety. Learn what each food date label means, what is safe after it and how to track expiry dates.

item.title: How to time a whole dinner with several timers at once
item.description: Work backwards from serving time, start the longest job first and run one timer per dish. A simple method for timing a whole dinner so it all lands hot.

item.title: What to track in an endometriosis symptom diary (and what to bring to your appointment)
item.description: What to log in an endometriosis symptom diary (pain, cycle, bleeding, meds, impact) and how to turn it into a clear summary for your doctor.

item.title: Voltage drop: why a cable that carries the current can still be too long
item.description: A cable can carry the current and still be too long. How voltage drop is calculated, the 3 % and 5 % limits, and when to size the cable up.
